summary_zh: 今日焦點：華碩、宏碁、惠普因AI推升零組件成本，將部分PC生產從泰國與越南遷回中國大陸，越南華商需重新評估代工產能布局與成本。越南第393/2026號法令將於12月5日生效，規範外籍勞工（在越南工作的外國人）工作許可延期流程；滅火器造假案則凸顯供應商原料與進料檢驗風險。
summary_en: Asus, Acer and HP are moving some PC output from Thailand and Vietnam back to mainland China as AI lifts component costs, prompting capacity reassessment. Decree 393/2026 on work permit extensions for foreign workers in Vietnam takes effect Dec 5; a fire extinguisher fraud case flags supplier quality risk.

items.summary_en: Ho Chi Minh City announced 12 approved investment projects with total new investment of about US$13.58 billion, covering ports, logistics and industrial production.
